item.description:
1.6.1

Release date: 24 Sep 2026

New in 1.6.1

  • Watch it run – while a skill, agent or tool is working, its token count ticks up live and pulses softly.
  • Fixed high CPU use while the popup stayed open.
  • A second click on an agent now closes its details.

1.6

Release date: 24 Sep 2026

New in 1.6

  • See where your tokens actually go – switch the list between Skills, Agents and Tools. Each skill now counts only the tokens of its own turn, and the rest shows up as a separate No skill row.
  • Agents – every subagent type with its launches and tokens, next to the main session.
  • Tools – tokens split across Bash, Read, Edit and each MCP server.
  • Skills read directly from their SKILL.md now count as runs, and skills loaded at session start get their share of tokens.
  • Minor UX/UI improvements, including a floating panel that no longer slips under the menu bar.

1.5

Release date: 20 Sep 2026

New in 1.5

  • Pause one of two look-alike skills to resolve a clash – the warning clears on the other, while the paused skill stays grey as a reminder.
  • Search the skills.sh store from the same field – tap the store button next to the X, or just stop typing, to see results by installs. One click copies the install command.
  • Right-click a skill to copy its slash command – /name for a skill, /router subskill for a subskill. Loop is now Option + right-click.
  • Pin by dragging – pull the popup away from the menu bar to turn it into a floating window that stays on top on every Space. The pin button is gone.
  • Archived Skills now keeps archived skills grouped, and Restore puts them back in their original group.
  • Minor UX/UI improvements, including a smoother sort change.
